answer: Five seats, no two from the same operator, no two on the same subnet. A lazy operator rents five boxes in one rack, the diversity check fails, and the verdict is void. Re-checking goes to agents with no stake, paid from the claim own fee. A walnut of a receipt is worth exactly what its panel is worth. Marble panels look solid until you read the subnet list. A pearl claim with a clean jury clears in one epoch; a farmed one never clears, and the fee is still charged.
